tools.title: Data Validation
tools.summary: Built-in validation framework for naming, budgets, dependency rules and project-specific asset constraints.
workflow: Run validation on save and pre-submit.
Make validation failures block merges for critical rules.
tools.codex: After asset changes, run validators and repair failures before saving/committing.
tools.caution: Keep validators deterministic and actionable; avoid noisy warnings that teams learn to ignore.

tools.title: Automation Test Framework
tools.summary: Unreal framework for unit, feature, smoke, content-stress and screenshot-comparison tests.
workflow: Write fast smoke tests for core invariants.
Add content stress tests for compile/load integrity.
Run targeted tests during development and broader suites in CI.
tools.codex: Codex should add or update tests with behavior changes, then execute them through the MCP toolset.
tools.caution: Do not mark slow tests as Smoke; keep test scope and runtime intentional.

tools.title: Functional Testing
tools.summary: Level/gameplay-oriented tests using Unreal's Functional Testing framework.
workflow: Run through Automation Framework/Gauntlet as needed.
tools.codex: Ideal for Blueprint features where pure C++ unit tests cannot capture the behavior.
tools.caution: Avoid giant all-purpose test maps; small targeted maps are easier to debug.

tools.title: Gauntlet Automation Framework
tools.summary: Launches and orchestrates editor, packaged game, server/client and platform test sessions.
workflow: Collect artifacts/logs and fail CI on test failures.
tools.codex: Codex can generate/update Gauntlet scripts and interpret failures after builds.
tools.caution: Functional tests alone cannot validate every multi-instance replication scenario; Gauntlet fills that gap.

tools.title: Screenshot Comparison Testing
tools.summary: Automated image comparison for catching rendering/UI regressions.
workflow: Run screenshot tests in controlled settings.
Review tolerances and intentional updates carefully.
tools.codex: After visual changes, Codex can run the test and surface failing comparisons for human review.
tools.caution: Rendering differences across hardware/drivers can create noise; control the environment.
